task: Estimate the source snapshot share count of a news article from publication-date and content-statistic features.
context: n_tokens*: word counts; n_unique_tokens/n_non_stop*: source token ratios; num_*: link/image/video/keyword counts; data_channel_*: channel flags; weekday_* and is_weekend: publication-day flags. Sentiment/subjectivity fields are source-derived text statistics. price-like keyword popularity, referenced-article share statistics, LDA topic scores, URLs and elapsed collection time are excluded. This is a retrospective snapshot task, not a fixed-horizon popularity forecast.
